profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer en MPG | Liderando equipos técnicos en proyectos AAA | +15 años haciendo juegos, gestionando personas y resolviendo problemas
profile.summary:
I lead technical development at MPG, where I currently work on AAA projects like Fall Guys. My commitment is to ensure that our projects are created with top-tier game logic, efficiency, and cutting-edge technology, keeping a strong focus on both software quality and user experience.

Senior developer/manager with a 15+ year track record in creating video games and software, from small projects to AAA productions. Throughout my career, I have managed and mentored development teams of various sizes, combining a business-oriented vision and entrepreneurial mindset with working shoulder-to-shoulder with the technical team and providing deep technical expertise.

I consider myself a natural problem solver, capable of adapting to any language, engine, or situation with a proactive attitude. Eager to create games that make people happy, while building healthy and efficient teams. 

Besides that, I like playing video games, board games, practicing martial arts, and listening to good rock music.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical Leadership & Management: Driving technical execution in co-development AAA video game projects for global clients, leading and mentoring software engineering teams.
- Key Titles: Active technical contributions and ongoing support for massive, high-profile titles such as Fall Guys.
- Stakeholder Management: Acting as a direct liaison with client engineering teams to align architecture, coordinate milestones, and clear technical blockers.
- Engineering Excellence: Fostering software best practices, code reviews, and ensuring scalable, high-performance game logic in large-scale productions.
positions.insights: Skills: Liderazgo de equipos de desarrollo · Gestión de ingeniería de software · Desarrollo de videojuegos · Arquitectura de software

positions.title: Videogames developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the technical development and cross-functional support for the mobile game Monster Masters EX.
- Assisted in code optimization, bug fixing, and feature implementation within an agile development workflow.

positions.title: CTO & Co-founder
positions.description:
- Team Leadership & Management: Head of technical direction and direct team management, fostering a healthy, high-performing engineering culture.
- Technical Strategy & Architecture: Responsible for global architectural choices, code quality assurance, and performance optimization across multiplatform titles.
- Business Development & Client Relations: Direct client management, technical scoping, proposal creation, and securing external outsourcing contracts.
- Tech Stack & Tooling: Overseeing and developing Unity3D mobile games, backend tooling (Symfony/PHP), and web ecosystem (WordPress).
- Featured Titles: Los viajes de Julia, Jack21, and Real Money Bowling.
positions.insights: Skills: Liderazgo de equipos multidisciplinarios · Unity 3D · Arquitectura de software · Espíritu empresarial · Desarrollo empresarial

positions.title: Games developer
positions.description:
- Worked in AAA projects like Asphalt Xtreme and Love Boat.
- Winner of national videogame industry Best Tech award in Gamelab 2017.
- Mainly focused in UI and client-side tasks with C++.
- Collaborated with tools on server-side with PHP and stress tests hand-on-hand with the CTO.

positions.title: Indie Developer & Freelance
positions.description:
- Created a small mobile arcade game in Unity3D in collaboration with an artist
- Developed DiarioMenu and Nike's Storebook iOS apps in Objective-C as a freelance

positions.title: Games Developer
positions.description:
- Worked in manager games like NBA General Manager, Real Madrid Fantasy Manager, NFL Manager
among other big football clubs manager games.
- Developed all aspects of mobile side of the game for iOS with Objective-C.
- Handled AppStore setup and publishing details of the releases.
- Ended up in charge of all the american licensed games development on iOS.
- Also collaborated in Flip Football project made in Unity3D.

positions.title: IOS apps developer
positions.description:
- Worked in iOS apps like MiFarmaciaOnline or Interdulces
- Full-cycle app development for iOS with Objective-C

positions.title: Junior Games developer
positions.description:
- Trabajé en el juego de estrategia Mechanized, y en el motor de juegos para móviles utilizado en Airport Mania y Ranch Rush 2
- Desarrollaba IA, gameplay, interfaz de usuario y economía en C++
- Empecé como becario y continué desarrollando juegos después de las prácticas

projects.title: NBA General Manager 2015
projects.description:
MANAGE GAME BY GAME AND BEAT YOUR OPPONENTS
A timely change can be vital when it comes to the final result. Managing your players isn’t always easy, but great management will bring you great success
